responsibility: Provides small GNARL thread-support shims that isolate Ada runtime tasking code from platform-specific pthread and clock details. In particular, it initializes pthread condition-variable attributes to use GNAT’s selected tasking clock when that clock differs from the default POSIX realtime clock, and it supplies a fallback routine to query clock resolution on systems such as Darwin that lack the usual POSIX interface. The file therefore owns low-level C helpers used by the Ada tasking runtime to configure timed waits and obtain clock timing characteristics in a portable way.
